title: C*-irreducible regular inclusions, Galois correspondence and aperiodicity
summary: We characterise C*-irreducible regular C*-inclusions using a number of different conditions considered by different authors. In particular, we show that all C*-irreducible regular inclusions $A\subseteq B$ are modelled by outer Fell bundles $(B_{g})_{g\in G}$ over discrete groups with a simple unit fibre $A=B_1$. In this case, we prove a bijection between intermediate C*-algebras $A\subseteq C \subseteq B$ and subgroups $H$ of $G$.
